title: On the existence and properties of Alexandroff paratopological groups
summary: We study groups endowed with Alexandroff topologies and show that no non-discrete Alexandroff topology can turn a group into a topological group. This settles negatively the basic existence problem for Alexandroff topological groups. Motivated by this obstruction, we turn to the broader setting of Alexandroff paratopological groups. We establish several fundamental properties of these spaces regarding to connections and compact-like properties among others.
